mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, here is today's balanced dish: expect 62 degrees and partly cloudy skies near Badger Ridge Middle School. The moon is in its Waxing Gibbous phase, and while the ISS is passing overhead tonight, you won't be able to see it due to the clouds. Tonight will cool down to 50 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

City engineering reports from September 2026 have been added to the city website, and residents should prepare for the fall leaf collection program which kicks off on October 5. Remember to keep leaf piles clear of obstacles like hydrants and parked cars.

Today is a busy day for our community! You can visit the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park, join Trivia Night at The Bogey Factory, or enjoy Pizza and a Pitcher at Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, Hop Haus is hosting trivia tomorrow, and the popular Verona Fall Fest is happening on September 25.

In police news, officers responded to an incident on September 5 involving a vehicle traveling 83 miles per hour in a 65 mile per hour zone on the highway. The driver was arrested for an O W I and cited for operating after revocation.

Today's flavor at the Verona Culver's is the delightful Turtle Dove. The store is currently open and will remain open until 10:00 PM, so there is still plenty of time to stop by for a treat this evening.
